messages.subject: Energy & Natural Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Principal Search Team,

Your executive-search work across energy, commodities and natural resources is highly relevant to my leadership background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy and resources growth requires credible institutional engagement, regulatory discipline and responsible execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
